_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored. Every value can also be set by env var (see README).

jira.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC

google._comment: Calendar + Gmail share one OAuth connection. refresh_token is written by the wizard after you sign in — don't paste it by hand.

slack._comment: Use a user token (xoxp- or xoxe.xoxp-); only that has your read state. channels holds the IDs you marked important.
slack._rotation: Only needed for xoxe.xoxp- tokens, which expire after 12 hours. With these three set the app renews itself; expires_at is maintained for you.

catercow._comment: No public API. Selections are inferred from confirmation emails (needs the Google connection; subjects only) and/or a signed-in page fetched with a session cookie.
catercow._lunch_days: 0 = Monday. Weekdays that expect a selection.
